messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time"
set: ["you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "you may need a higher dose for a short time", "may need a lower dose or need to stop taking the medicine for a short period or for good", "doctor may tell to stop taking for short time", "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency", "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure", "doctor may stop the medicine", "may need to temporarily stop taking", "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol", "may need to stop use before imaging tests", "you do not need to shake before using", "doctor should review from time to time whether you still need it", "may only need to take for a few days for acute pain", "you may need to use blood pressure medication for the rest of your life", "check medicine each time you get a refill to ensure correct form", "you should not stop using carvedilol suddenly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
